digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend adapter seam / Jira-family layer
propositions: ADR 0035 must be amended to record the jira_family sub-seam layer, its two parameterizing contracts (RichTextCodec, UserIdentityModel), and the shared-jira provenance decision deferring vocabulary generalization to epic be74

The Backend contract suite certifies a backend only when the port is complete and typed; the TicketTransport declares six members but the core reaches for twenty-one distinct members, with twelve absent and undeclared, evidenced by a live crash (set_entity_property) while isinstance/contract-suite/unit tests passed

RemoteRef.instance is described in ADR 0035 as an existing deployment-distinguishing mechanism but is never constructed in production code (src/ contains only the dataclass definition and test helpers), creating a gap that must be named and tracked rather than asserted as implemented

Data Center reaches read-only status on 28 March 2029, making this a deliberately time-boxed investment for self-hosted clients with the durable asset being the family seam rather than the DC adapter itself

The documented operator commands for DC backend selection and PAT configuration must be executed against a real Jira Data Center instance to verify the user-guide and validate security properties (never read PAT from config), not assumed to work from unit tests
